name: TWISTER MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-TWM-100X Twister Mill (Cyclone Mill) is highly utilized in the food, feed, and pharmaceutical industries. It is specifically used for ultra-fast, uniform grinding of dry, brittle samples like grains, seeds, and tobacco prior to NIR analysis. The integrated cyclone mechanism automatically separates the ground sample, drastically increasing throughput.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS TWISTER MILL is a high-speed cyclone impact mill engineered for ultra-fine, uniform pulverization of dry, brittle matrices such as cereals, oilseeds, pulses, feed pellets, and tobacco. The mill operates by accelerating particles in a 1.1 kW rotor at up to 16,000 rpm with a peripheral speed of 82 m/s; impact and shear against a selected 0.3–1.0 mm sieve ring reduce sample size, while the integrated cyclone separator removes the ground fraction, minimizing heat and cross-contamination. This standardized grinding is critical for reproducible NIR/FT-NIR and reference wet-chemistry analyses of moisture, crude protein, crude fat, starch, ash, crude fiber, and mycotoxins such as aflatoxins and ochratoxin A in food, feed, and pharmaceutical QC laboratories. It supports ISO 12099, AOAC, and AACC methods and is suitable for B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers, food chemists, agronomists, and quality-control analysts preparing grains, seeds, feed, and tobacco samples.
sop: Ensure the mill is placed on a stable, vibration-free bench and connected to a 220V 50Hz earthed power supply.
Wear appropriate PPE: safety goggles, dust mask, ear protection, and lab coat.
Select and install the required sieve (0.3 mm, 0.5 mm, 0.8 mm, or 1.0 mm) and attach a clean 250 ml cyclone collection bottle.
Switch on the main power switch and allow the control panel to initialize.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Ensure the feeding hopper is empty and the sample particles are dry and below 10 mm in size; fill the batch volume to no more than 250 ml.
Start the mill and feed the sample slowly and uniformly into the hopper to avoid overloading or clogging.
Allow the cyclone to separate and collect the ground sample; wait until no residual material is observed in the discharge path.
Switch off the motor, collect the labeled ground sample from the bottle, and close tightly for subsequent NIR or reference analysis.
Clean the mill, sieve, and cyclone components with a soft brush or laboratory vacuum between runs to prevent cross-contamination.

SAFETY WARNING: Never open the grinding chamber or place hands near the rotor while the motor is running or coasting; switch off and unplug the mill and wait for complete rotor stop before cleaning or changing sieves, and never process flammable, explosive, high-moisture, or sticky samples.
features: Maximum 16000 rpm speed setting with rotor peripheral speed of 82 m/s
Cyclone separator collects samples quickly and reduces cleaning time
High speed powerful motor ensures high grinding efficiency
Soft touch control panel design for easy operation
Supplied with 0.3mm & 0.8mm sieves and 250ml sample bottles
